name: Tata Chemicals Limited
remarksWeb: 1. Consequent to a Scheme of Arrangement sanctioned by the Honble National Company Law Tribunal, 10,060 equity shares of Tata Chemicals Limited held by TMF Business Services Limited (Formerly Tata Motors Finance Limited, Promoter Group) have been transferred to Tata Motors Finance Limited (Formerly Tata Motors Finance Solutions Limited). Further, consequent to the merger approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, Tata Motors Finance Limited (formerly known as Tata Motors Finance Solutions Limited) has merged with Tata Capital Limited w.e.f. May 8, 2025. Accordingly, the Company has reported 10,060 shares against Tata Capital Limited within the Promoter Group.  2. Pursuant to the scheme of arrangement between Tata Coffee Limited, TCPL Beverages & Foods Limited and Tata Consumer Products Limited, 150 shares of Tata Chemicals Limited held by Tata Coffee Limited have been transferred to Tata Consumer Products Limited. Accordingly, the Company has reported 150 shares against Tata Consumer Products Limited within the Promoter Group. 3. Mgage SA de CV ceased to be the Promoter Group Entity w.e.f. October 1, 2025 as the entity is wound up and deemed liquidated. 4. Tata Capital Advisors Pte. Limited ceased to be the Promoter Group Entity w.e.f. October 31, 2025 pursuant to its amalgamation with Tata Capital Pte. Limited. 5. Tata Capital General Partners LLP, Tata Capital Healthcare General Partners LLP, Tata Opportunities General Partners LLP, Tata Capital Growth II General Partners LLP, Tata Capital Healthcare II General Partners LLP, and Tata Capital Growth III General Partners LLP are LLPs incorporated in the form of General Partners who are restricted from making any investment in the underlying portfolio company and only the respective Funds managed/controlled by them are allowed to invest in these portfolio companies. In view of the same, the Company had not included these LLPs within the scope of  Promoter Group Companies (PGC). However, as a matter of good governance, the Company has now included these LLPs in PGC list.
